items.question: Are making a forehead-mark with lead substances and sitting on deer skin prohibited actions?
premises: A forehead-mark should not be made with lead-born substances.
One should not sit upon a deer skin.
Both actions are enjoined as things to avoid.
items.inference: Therefore, applying a lead forehead-mark and sitting on deer skin are forbidden.
uncertainties: The precise substance denoted by nāgaja in this ritual context may be lead or another lead-derived material.
items.plain_english: One should not make a forehead-mark with lead substances, nor should one sit on a deer skin.
